desc.zh: 一个经济体“好不好”，到底是怎么量出来的？从 GDP 三面等价、物价指数与 CPI、增长率陷阱、PPP 与基尼系数、劳动力市场、周期与萨姆规则、索洛分解，到 GDP 边界与 2025 SNA 前沿。
desc.en: How do we measure how well an economy is doing? From the three-sided GDP identity, price indexes and CPI, growth-rate traps, PPP and Gini, labour markets, business cycles and the Sahm rule, and Solow growth accounting to GDP boundaries and the 2025 SNA frontier.

title.zh: GDP 三面等价与增加值

desc.zh: 生产法、支出法与收入法为何必然相等，为何减去进口不是“进口拉低 GDP”，以及无偿家务的生产边界。
desc.en: Why production, expenditure, and income approaches must match, why subtracting imports cancels out, and where the production boundary sits.

title.zh: 名义与实际、链式费雪指数与替代偏差
title.en: Nominal vs Real, Chained Fisher & Substitution Bias

desc.zh: 拉氏指数、帕氏指数与链式费雪指数如何拆开价与量，替代偏差从何而来，以及 CPI 与 GDP 平减指数的分叉。
desc.en: How Laspeyres, Paasche, and chained Fisher indexes separate price from quantity, why substitution bias arises, and how CPI diverges from the GDP deflator.

title.zh: CPI 权重、等价租金 OER 与质量调整
title.en: CPI Weights, Owners' Equivalent Rent & Hedonic Adjustment

desc.zh: 为什么个人体感通胀常偏离官方 CPI：篮子权重、自住业主等价租金（OER）、特征价格质量调整与核心通胀。
desc.en: Why personal inflation differs from official CPI: expenditure weights, owners' equivalent rent, hedonic quality adjustments, and core CPI/PCE.

title.zh: 折年率、基数效应、季节调整与数据修订
title.en: Annualised Rates, Base Effects, Seasonal Adjustment & Revisions

desc.zh: 环比折年与同比的区别、低基数回声、2×4 中心移动平均季调失灵，以及 ALFRED 真实 GDP 历史修订档案。
desc.en: q/q SAAR vs y/y, base-effect echoes, seasonal adjustment shifts, and real-time ALFRED GDP vintage revisions (2008Q4, 2020Q2, 2022H1).

en: quarter over quarter vs year over year

title.zh: 购买力平价 PPP、均值与中位数及基尼系数
title.en: Purchasing Power Parity, Mean vs Median & Gini Coefficient

desc.zh: 巴拉萨–萨缪尔森效应为何让低工资国家按 PPP 的 GDP 翻倍，以及顶层集中增长下人均 GDP 与中位数的分化。
desc.en: Why the Balassa-Samuelson effect boosts PPP GDP in lower-wage economies, and how top-heavy growth splits mean GDP per capita from median income.

title.zh: U-3 与 U-6 失业率、贝弗里奇曲线与奥肯定律
title.en: U-3 vs U-6 Unemployment, Beveridge Curve & Okun's Law

desc.zh: 灰心退出求职如何“美化”U-3、劳动参与率、美国 2001–2026 贝弗里奇曲线轨迹，以及跨越时期的奥肯定律斜率漂移。
desc.en: How discouraged workers distort U-3, labour force participation, the 2001-2026 US Beveridge curve trajectory, and shifting Okun's law slopes.

title.zh: 经济周期、潜在产出与萨姆规则
title.en: Business Cycles, Potential Output & the Sahm Rule

desc.zh: 为什么“两季负增长”不是 NBER 衰退标准、萨姆规则 1960–2026 的 11 次触发与 2024 年假阳性，以及 CBO 潜在产出修订。
desc.en: Why two negative quarters do not define an NBER recession, all 11 Sahm rule triggers including July 2024, and revisions to CBO potential output.

title.zh: 索洛增长核算与全要素生产率（TFP）
title.en: Solow Growth Accounting & Total Factor Productivity

desc.zh: 产出增长如何拆成资本、工时、人力资本与“无知余数” TFP，以及 1960–2023 美国战后生产率分解实证。
desc.en: Decomposing growth into capital, hours, human capital, and the TFP residual across US postwar eras (1960-2023 Penn World Table & FRED).

title.zh: GDP 之外：家务、折旧、灾难悖论与卫星账户
title.en: Beyond GDP: Home Production, Depreciation & Disaster Paradox

desc.zh: BEA 家务卫星账户（约占 23%–26%）、国内生产净值 NDP、飓风重建推高 GDP 的会计悖论与环境外部性。
desc.en: Household production satellite accounts (~23-26%), net domestic product NDP, why disaster reconstruction raises GDP while destroying wealth, and environmental costs.

title.zh: 前沿测量：免费数字品、GDP-B、2025 SNA 与实时预测
title.en: Measurement Frontier: Free Digital Goods, GDP-B, 2025 SNA & Nowcasting

desc.zh: 零元数字服务与消费者剩余（GDP-B）、2025 年 3 月联合国 2025 SNA 新标准、调查回复率下跌与央行实时预测。
desc.en: Valuing zero-price digital services and AI via GDP-B, the March 2025 SNA overhaul, declining survey response rates, and real-time central-bank nowcasting.
